_doc: Landing variant for check n (death at speed over intact tiles): no weaving, so the Burrowers trail their players along the path lane; from follow second 6 (kill_over_tiles_min_s) the run fires Aura.Burrower.KillAll at the first moment a server Burrower moves faster than kill_over_tiles_min_speed with J0_Head, J2_Midbody and J4_Tail each above an intact hex tile (kill_when_over_tiles; R['kill_over_tiles'] records which, its speed and heights); timeout 40 s -> kill anyway. The corpses must come to rest on the tiles (n_death_landing), carry forward (l_death_momentum), and checks a..d, f, h, i, j, k, m, o as in the turns run.
